rules.statement: A landlocked lot resulting from a subdivision retains the right to access a public road via a necessary way over intervening subdivided lots, not necessarily the shortest route.
rules.supporting_quote: "in the case of a subdivided property, the owners of each of the subdivisions will be entitled to the use of a way of necessity to which the undivided property was entitled, and if any of the subdivisions are cut off from access to the right of way, the owner is entitled to a road over intervening subdivisions to enable him to reach it."
